digest.component_or_area: rebar metrics command and passive instrumentation
propositions: Agent-driven dev loop lacks aggregation layer and durable history of lifecycle signals (env-diagnosis intervals, bug provenance, bug classification) needed to surface trending metrics
Tier-C blindspots (env/integration-diagnosis, bug causation attribution, bug outcome classification) leave no trace in the event store and cannot be derived structurally from existing events
Auto-derived caused_by edges from git blame must bypass closed-source guards on the bug (already closed when blame runs) by writing directly to the link event stream
Bug-close CLI must replace (not supplement) required free-text reason with a bounded --class enum persisted on the STATUS event, keeping required-argument count flat
Snapshot series must be git-tracked at .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson (not under reports/ which is gitignored) to persist code-health metrics computed ephemerally in CI
Command must emit all registered metrics for any date range, with unavailable metrics reporting structured reason and accrual-start timestamp rather than omitting the key
